title: NytrixFM Cobblebreaker
description: This mod add a cobblebreaker, an block who break cobblestone into vanilla ores.
body:
# 🙌 Welcome on the Cobblebreaker modrinth page !
The cobble breaker is a mod who add a block named Cobblebreaker who break cobblestone into vanilla ores.

## 🧇The list of ores genered by the cobble breaker with his probability of spawn.
- Redstone (70%)
- Iron (50%)
- Gold (20%)
- Diamond (4%)
- Emerald (1%)
